articles.author: Wu Capital Ltd and Xinyi Cai
articles.headline: Wu Capital and Xinyi Cai report 10.79% beneficial ownership of Jinxin Technology
sourceWarnings: La fecha de referencia de la participación es 30 de junio; el registro se publicó el 6 de agosto. No acredita una compra nueva ese día. Las acciones ordinarias no equivalen a ADS.
articles.summary: Wu Capital and Xinyi Cai disclosed 10.79% beneficial ownership of Jinxin's ordinary shares in an amended Schedule 13G. This reports ownership as of an earlier measurement date, not a newly completed August purchase; ordinary shares are distinguished from ADSs.
articles.timestampEvidence: StockTitan explicit SEC acceptance August 6 16:06 EDT, with original SEC issuer 1967631 filing accession 0002056465-26-000003. June 30 is the ownership event date, not publication.
